content: Yesus Bégur 12 Qe Kekuak Maran
Yesus Bégur 12 qe uŕwarew dog. Doweg ge, nug koulli nou kunum geŕarlagri am waŕe kowol kowol ole kusqarlagri gagragsak am kuakri wittak ole maran.
Am nug Né Kena “Tiwur king delle danahas nusgur gumardigri” qe kusulagri am waŕe danah seweg pasaorlagri ole anew ateg.
Yesus amlagwa anan, “Ag weiyakri sénwa kité os aw oweg. Ag durqak sokét, baram, ke, qarég am siot aŕit os aw oweg.
Ag lo arewa diarweg nuksi pe, ag qewa ih dessi ole taun qe mineksi ates.
Gam danahas ag fel pi qaressi diareksi loulagwa pi atweg pe, ag taun qe mineksi atessi ge félagwari usuŕ qeqlessi ates. Ag kowol qe peksi ge, kowol nou asilag qe olag mourdig.”
Géri Yesus Bégur ateksi kaw kunumba weiyessi, Né Kena kuswessi am waŕe danah atu kunumbari seweg pasaoŕeg.
Herod Yesusri Katat Qan
Herod Antipas nug Galili dilag king. Nug Yesus Bégur ole kuak seg qeri né doko katat qan. Keŕdi danah os ge aneg, “Le Luarak danah Yon buliko siran.”
Am os ge aneg, “Elaisa gumarko duan.” Am la os aneg, “Profet
os algunah mousan qe buliko siran.”
Géri Herod anan, “Da anwi Yon fag iŕil kotŕeg. Gam danah qe ounnah nusig kuak am kowol ole mariweg duina?” eko anan. Géri nug Yesus perigri dahman.
Yesus 5,000 Danah Ke Maran
Yesusri aposel
bulieksi uŕiyeksi keke kunum seg qeri nug amegwa marieg. Qe dimba ge, nug omlarew, danah la minareksi ag agé kaw os wénih Betsaida qewa ateg.
Gam danahas dueksi ge, nug dimlamdeksi ateg. Ag nugnéwa atweg ge, nug felqarelle Tiwur king delle danahas nusgur gumardigri né qe kuswew dueg. Am danah os waŕe ole qe sew pasaoŕeg.

Kem noko tueh manew ge, Bégur 12 qe duksi Yesus amegwa aneg. “Na danahas anwe atares. Ag kaw naŕi am kaw nounu unaka dassi qewa ateksi niak awen am ke lakri os ole maries. Awen ig datu ole ene ge danah kawa,” éksi aneg.
Anweg ge, Yesus buliko anaran, “Ag agégé ke mares.” Gam Bégur 12 qe aneg, “Ig ke kuŕum ole kawa, beret tanig ole am kaké aŕit ole ih de. Ig atektu danahas ene kunum dilag ke daren te méktu marnig?”
(5,000 danah keke qere qewa deg.) Yesus nug bégur amlagwa anan, “Ag danahas amlagwa anweg, qaglak ameg 50, 50 qere qagleksi des.”
Yesus nug anan sillah, bégur né nusig dimlamdeksi anweg danahas kunum ninapiŕessi deg.
Yesus beret tanig ole am kaké aŕit qe ole oko saw karan amnelle kena sam elle keri unuqoran. Malako ge, temelle bégur danahas agop panilagri maran.
Géri danahas kunum ke léksi olag oŕwew ge, ke big big minareg qe Yesus Bégur diareksi kaleg 12 qere yanareg.
Pita Né Kopatko Yesus Ge Kristus Eko Anan
Deŕ os Yesus bégur ole dessi am nug nugé kepaŕko unuqorewew, am bégur gumdeksi doweg koŕmaran. “Danahas dasil ge oun éksi ansi?”
Nug bégur aneg, “Os ge Le Luarak danah Yon éksi ansi. Am os ge Elaisa éksi anirsi. Am la os ge profet os algunah mousan qe buliko siran éksi ansi.”
Anweg ge, Yesus bégur koŕmaran, “Gam ag ge dasil oun éksi ansi?” Pita anan, “Na Tiwurdi Kristus
, Tiwur danahas nusgur bulika diardipri toqiran.”
Géri né qe danah os amegwa anwegri Yesus bégur gun qaran.
Yesus Mousko Am Buliko Asdigri Anan

Am Yesus amlagwa anan, “Meŕenah, danah Bega geisah gurak kuŕum morlag. Kuri danah am pris dilag anqak danah ole am Mosesri Ŕo duak danah ole geisah nug dimoreksi, am qeweg mousdig. Gam deŕ kiamba ge buliko sirdig.”
Anko ge, buliko danahas kunum anaran, “Danah os da dimlamiŕdigri dew ge, nug nugégé nusig sak am o mourak ole qe dimorko, am ker mawanak nusig deŕ dorog mouko ge da dimlamŕar.
Danah os nug nugégé nusig sak am o mourak ole dimlamurko ge, nug foumak ospi ow. Gam danah os nug da dimlamŕelle mousko ge, foumak oko sansan darig.
Am danah nug wan kénih ole delle mousew ge, keke qe ospinah kéhnurweg.
Am danah os dasil am né dasildi uŕa new pe, sén Danah Bega nug nusig kamsahlak gun olewa am Memegriwa am Tiwurdi doup gun dilagwa uŕirig ge, danah qeri uŕa nérig.
Da ag amlagwa meŕenah anina. Danah os ewa aséw dasi ge, geisah ag pi mousak, Tiwur king delle danahas nusgur gumarewew pelag,” eko anan.
Yesusri Kamsahlak Gun Ole Bégur Peg
Yesus né qe anko malwew, deŕ 8 keke qere atew ge, nug unuqurdigri Pita, Yon am Yems ole diarew qoukuwa teg.
Nug unuqorelle dewew ge, nug kitŕu ge buliko sonŕewew am nug féŕu bala qe ole ampiŕ sillah sonŕan.
Usihri danah aŕit Moses Elaisa ole kamsahlak gun olewa dowes nug ole né marieg.
Yesus nug wagam kawa Tiwurdi Né dimlamurko olele morko Yerusalem mousdigri danah aŕit qe ole marieg.
Pita leikuŕ aŕit qe ole amlag kug morew nilag seg. Gam sén amlag fou mew ge, danah aŕit qe am Yesus ole aseksi kamsahlak gun ole qe owa deppeg piareg.
Danah aŕit qe Yesus mundeksa ateppes, Pita Yesus amegwa anan. “Danah naŕi, ig ewa dalom ge kena. Ig laklak kiam os sénig, os nasip am os Mosesri, am os Elaisari.” (Pita nug o pi mourak né qe anan.)
Nug né qe anewew ge, fur os doko tonarew owa dessi olag faŕan.
Tiwur fur owa anan, “Ene nir dasilnah. Da nug algu toqurin. Ag nug fag duessi dimlamdes.”
Tiwur né qe anko malwew ge, ag Yesus nugé dewew peg. Am bégur ag sén qe keke peg qeri né ospi marieg, asilag dahmakwa ih dian.
Yesus Nir Os Koulli Nou Ole Sew Kena Man
Deŕ qe dimba ge, Yesus am bégur kiam qe ole qoukuwari noppeg, danahas ameg naŕi uŕiyeksi Yesus ihwa peg.
Am danah os danahas ameg naŕi qe olagwa uŕwan, “Duak marak danah, na da nal ene peripri nuqrina. Da nir danah usihnah enan ih.
Koulli nou os nir qe owa now ge, gelelle ole usihri atko kauŕko kawqelle sihŕu newew nie. Koulli nou qe nir ofeŕ ospi paŕwe, am féŕu sew nounah me.
Da na begpar koulli nou ene geŕurlagri nuqarin, gam ag sakri olele kawa.”
Géri Yesus anan, “Danahas geiri, ag olag meŕe mak ole kawa am olag ge mangu kawa. Sén gane da ag ole dettu olag meŕe mérigri amlag méril?” elle ge anan, “Nir nasip oka ere do,” eko anan.
Nir nag qe Yesus gumurko dowew ge, koulli nou qe touŕew atko wanwa qeko kawqelle nian. Géri Yesus koulli nou qe nir qe paŕorigri gaŕa morko geŕdan. Geŕurko nir qe sew kena mew ge, buliko memeg moran.
Géri danahas kunum Tiwurdi gagragsak qe peksi dorlag nan. Danahas qe Yesus keŕ keŕ kunum san qe peksi dorlag new seppeg, nug bégur anaran.
“Né andil seina, ene dossi koutores! Danah os Danah Bega kegeŕ ewlagwa mérig,” eko anan.
Gam bégur ag né qe olag pi mouran. Tiwur sew né digu qe larian, qeri ag olag ospi mouran. Am ag Yesus né qeri koŕmorakri faŕeg.
Oun Nug Naŕi?
Yesus bégur ag koŕlagwa ih oun nug naŕi asilag qeri kareg.
Yesus dahmak asilag qe doko ge, nir nag os oko doko nug dianwa man.

Meko ge, nug amlagwa anan. “Oun os nug da wénilwa nir nag ene sillah oko dahmore ge, nug da dahmiŕe. Keŕdi nug dasil o meŕe me qeri qere se. Am oun nug da wiŕe ge, nug Tiwur da anew uŕiyin qe o. Géri oun ag kallolagwa de qe, nug naŕi.”
Yon anan, “Danah naŕi, ig danah os na wénimba koulli nou geŕarew pektu anurhut minan. Keŕdi nug ig ole pi weitu.”
Gam Yesus anaran, “Ag nug aw dagorweg. Oun nug ag kegeŕ pi mare ge, nug ag leilag,” eko anan.
Samaria Yesus Kawlagwa Nuakri Mineg
Yesus wan minko saw kappa attigri sén durmurew ge, Yesus o kunum morko ole Yerusalem attigri atan.
Am nug danah os meŕarew anqeksi kaw os Samaria qewa keke dalagri am ke lelagri qe kunum bawarlagri ateg.
Gam danah kaw qewari ag dueg ge nug Yerusalem attigri atan qeri Yesus uksi loulagwa atakri mineg.
Yesus békuŕ Yems Yon ole, a né qe dueksa anes. “Naŕinah, na ot niew pe, i kew saw karandi anhuŕ aŕelle neko danah uni aŕardig!” eksa anes.
Gam Yesus buliko aŕit qe gaŕa matan.
Qe dimba ge, Yesus bégur ole kaw lawa ateg.
Yesus Dimlamdakri Kowol
Ag ihwa ateksi ge, danah os Yesusri anan, “Na arewa attip ge, da na dimlamirwi ole atnit.”
Yesus danah qe koŕewa oko anan, “Qé déguŕ ag wan oŕewa nisi am é ag teŕlag ole. Gam Danah Bega nug ge niakri lo ole kawa.”
Nug danah la os amegwa anan, “Na doka da dimlamiŕ,” eko anan. Gam danah qe anan, “Naŕinah, na minwe tatam ge da atko mem mousan suhumko am dimlamirdil,” eko anan.
Yesus danah qe amegwa anan, “Danah mousak qe minwe agé agé mousak leilgar qe suhmares. Gam na atka Tiwurdi Kingdomri
Né kusu.”
Am danah la os Yesusri anan, “Naŕinah, da na dimlamirdil. Gam tatam na minwe da louw atwi ke séktu léktu ewlag oŕako am na dimlamirdil.”
Gam Yesus danah qe anoran, “Danah palangis digumeko toŕelle am sansan nug buliko dimugwa amne ole qe, nug Tiwurdi Kingdom owa kekuakri olele kawa,” eko anan.

footnotes.text: Danah os Yesus nugégé toqarko anew kekuak nusig séksi ateg ole qe. Aposel ge Yesusri meŕ danah.
Kristus ge Mesaia. Tiwur danahas nusgur buliko diardigri danah toqoran.
Ker mawanak mouko dimlamdak digu ge, nugégé nusig sak am o mourak dimorko am kug mawelle Tiwur dimlamdakri kowol.
Tiwur danahas nusgur dilag king delle gumare.
